The Assessor

A physician who stakes their credentials on every finding.

I am Dr. Enam Satti — a physician and clinical AI safety researcher. I built AegisMD because I saw what happens when AI systems reach clinical workflows without proper adversarial testing. The consequences are not abstract. They are patient safety events waiting to happen.

Every AegisMD assessment is conducted personally by me. Not a team. Not automated software. A physician who understands both the clinical context and the adversarial attack surface.
